title: CordataProcessingJobFacet
description: DSGVO Art. 30 fields, declared in the descriptor and travelling outward on the lineage event. A job facet rather than a run facet: purpose and legal basis are properties of the pipeline, not of one execution of it.

purpose.description: Why the processing happens, in the domain's own words.

legal_basis.description: The Art. 6 lawful basis. A closed set rather than a free string, so an invented basis cannot reach the generated processing record.
